text: Niedax is the brand of the Niedax Group, which 'became the official sleeve partner of Bayer 04 Leverkusen' for the 2024/25 season; the contract runs until 30 June 2027, with the Niedax Group's logo displayed on the sleeves of the Werkself first team's jersey.
short: Niedax Group is Bayer 04 Leverkusen's official sleeve partner

source.name: Niedax Group: Sponsorship (Who We Are)
source.quote: For the 2024/2025 season, our company became the official sleeve partner of Bayer 04 Leverkusen.
